reports.title: GB Metered Electricity Generation: 2026-11-17–2026-11-23
reports.intro: Seven complete Europe/London reporting days. Provisional, source-revisable readings; this is not a whole-system generation total.
reports.summary: Transmission-metered generation excluding pumped storage averaged 28.82 GW. Wind and natural hydro supplied 27.25% of that metered energy. Embedded estimates and imports are excluded.
reports.takeaway: Historical generation comparisons do not establish the cheapest or lowest-carbon time to use electricity today.
metrics: Wind + natural hydro share of metered generation
drivers: Highest daily-average metered wind: 13.12 GW on 2026-11-17.
Highest daily-average metered gas: 16.96 GW on 2026-11-23.
Pumped storage is separate: -18513.00 MWh signed net energy across the window; excluded from the generation denominator.

highlights.label: Embedded solar estimate
highlights.value: Embedded solar: 0.97 GW average across 2026-11-17–2026-11-23; NESO estimate, not included in metered totals.

highlights.label: Embedded wind estimate
highlights.value: Embedded wind: 1.40 GW average across 2026-11-17–2026-11-23; NESO estimate, not included in metered totals.

highlights.label: Carbon intensity
highlights.value: Published actual carbon intensity averaged 167.3 gCO₂/kWh (time-weighted). This is not a marginal-emissions or consumption-weighted measure.

reports.methodologyNote: Elexon transmission-metered generation; excludes imports, embedded estimates and pumped storage. Renewable share is wind plus natural hydro, excluding biomass. MW interval averages are integrated over half-hour durations. Optional estimates are not added to the denominator. Every included module requires all intervals across the entire window. Latest published Elexon revisions at retrieval are selected; conflicting equal-timestamp records fail validation. Original source responses and hashes are retained. Source-faithful validation is not independent certification. Publication remains provisional; later collections retain revised source evidence without silently rewriting archived reports.

coverage.aggregation: Energy divided by observed duration; shares are energy-weighted, not averages of percentages.

reports.publicationStatus: provisional; source records may be revised

yesterday.title: GB Metered Electricity Summary: 2026-11-23
yesterday.summary: On 2026-11-23, transmission-metered generation excluding pumped storage averaged 33.06 GW. Wind and natural hydro supplied 21.36% of metered energy. Imports and embedded estimates are excluded; source data may be revised.
